Arbolus | https://arbolus.com | Senior Software Engineer | Barcelona, Spain (hybrid, EU work authorization required) | Full-time

Arbolus enables professionals who purchase B2B tech products monetize their real-world experience through short consultations, surveys, and product knowledge exchange with top-tier investors and companies.

We are hiring senior full-stack engineers to work on engagement and incentive systems for our expert community, with real product and business ownership.

Stack: .NET (backend), React (frontend). Nice to have: cloud and applied AI experience. Team: ~25 engineers. Strong culture of debate, critical thinking, and disagreement.

Apply: https://careers.arbolus.com/jobs/7139985-senior-software-eng...
